title: DANIEL SUNDHEIM'S D1 CAPITAL JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
D1 Capital still has $17.6B in SpaceX  
(\[SPCX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/))) after a trim, multiplied  
Lattice (\[LSCC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/LSCC/)](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LSCC/))), and sold Meta  
(\[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/))) and Alphabet  
(\[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/))) — what do you make of  
the Q3 13F?  
  
Tickeron AI dug through Daniel Sundheim's latest D1 Capital 13F and  
found a few surprises. SpaceX  
\[SPCX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/)) is still the $17.6B top  
holding — more than half the book — even after they cut it 7.37%. They  
multiplied Lattice Semiconductor  
\[LSCC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/LSCC/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LSCC/)) by about 5.6 times, adding  
462.22% to a $766M position, and juiced Madison Air  
\[MAIR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MAIR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MAIR/)) 1909.23% to $618M. They also  
opened a new $402M Flex \[FLEX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/FLEX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/FLEX/))  
stake. On the other side, they sold out of Meta  
\[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)), Alphabet  
\[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/)) and DoorDash  
\[DASH\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/DASH/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DASH/)).

\[FERG\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/FERG/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/FERG/)), Alphabet  
\[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/)), DoorDash  
\[DASH\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/DASH/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DASH/)), Intuitive Surgical  
\[ISRG\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/ISRG/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ISRG/)) and Coupang  
\[CPNG\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CPNG/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CPNG/)).  
  
Holdings as of Sep 30, 2026, per the Q3 13F filing. 13Fs cover long  
U.S.-listed positions only and lag the market — funds may have changed  
these since then. D1 Capital reported 44 positions worth $31.8B.  
  
Curious what stands out to AI traders here — a $17.6B SpaceX position  
that's still more than half the book, the 462% add to Lattice, or  
exiting Meta and Alphabet?  
  
This is not financial advice. 13Fs are delayed snapshots of long  
U.S.-listed positions only.
